<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **10** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-record-context`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **209** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **20** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**80** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38`.

⛔ **16** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **20** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectName (symbol, 59 pages)`, `PERMISSION_DENIED (literal, 56 pages)`, `objectName (literal, 59 pages)`
- **30** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **191** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ff5ae6e11768ab90df895a75cbb3a69cbb8794d8` — the merge of head `f7c83f7ea54f5847f832cbb512367661f190b52c` into base `a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ff5ae6e11768ab90df895a75cbb3a69cbb8794d8 && git checkout ff5ae6e11768ab90df895a75cbb3a69cbb8794d8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38 f7c83f7ea54f5847f832cbb512367661f190b52c && git checkout -B drift-repro a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38 && git merge --no-ff f7c83f7ea54f5847f832cbb512367661f190b52c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a10345abfff2164453e6cfcca2e7d65d34a45f38` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `edba9689396d5010e32c316d273e5930ba156baf`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/index.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/record-context-tools.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/collection-item-owner-stamp.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/meta-url-data.generated.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md + packages/services/service-record-context/src/** (executor, read-set, door, body-outline, sentences, plugin, tests, fake door), packages/core/src/record-material-envelope.ts, packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts, packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts, packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts, packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts, packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/types.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts, packages/spec/liveness/ai_context.json and README row, .changeset/37140-*.md, .changeset/config.json, examples/app-showcase packs. Read-only outside the diff: mcp-relation-reads.ts, action-execution.ts, ADR-0160 on main.
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments
- **Read as the caller: holds.** Every record read is `door.get` / `door.query`, which are the bridges' own members: HTTP `callData` with the request's execution context and environment, and stdio `engine.find` with the resolved principal. There is no system context and no driver read. The service is stateless and resolved per request and per environment, so I found no cross-environment or cross-tenant path.
- **Order of judgement.** The root's guard, API exposure and served-ness all run before `listContextPacks` (record-context-tools.ts:244-257). Pack selection has no fallback: an unknown name and a pack on another object get the same answer (read-set.ts:62-71). Children are judged before projection, and lookup targets before reads (:275-355). The one exception is that a child's published definition is read before its gates (R2).
- **Field level.** Fields are projected onto the served definition. A hidden entry is stated once and never named. The #35137 naming reaches only fields that are served but unreadable. An unopenable lookup carries no id (:159-181). Unreadable related rows never arrive.
- **Envelope.** It is built only by `wrapRecordMaterial` (core/record-material-envelope.ts:49), which is called in one place (:485). Both doors reach it through the one executor.
- **Schema.** Strict, with the six v1 keys plus the kind-wide `MetadataProtectionFields`, following the `skill` precedent. The bounds 30 / 3 / 10 are refused at parse. The kind is registered on every surface D1 lists, with the `skill` row's flags. Each liveness row cites a real reader, and the type and its reader land together (ADR-0049).
- **SKILL.md.** It gains `aiContexts`, which is the key `stack.zod.ts:1228` accepts.
- **Body.** An unresolved anchor gets one `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` for each case: stale anchor, no body, hidden body and withheld body (:438-463). The 8000 and 20 constants are pinned (test :38-41).

### ② Semver level
`Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` are correct. The change is additive only: a new kind, a new collection key, new exports and one more door tool name. `minor` on each of the ten packages therefore matches AGENTS.md step 3. The `.changeset/config.json` edit puts the new package in the fixed group beside its sibling services. Downstream note: an exhaustive `Record` keyed on `MetadataType` outside this repo will need an `ai_context` row at the pin move, as it does for every kind admission.

### ③ Boundary flags
- **Lint is CLI-only.** This deviates from D1 and card item 1, which say "at save". The dev can't grant that deviation (R7).
- **Lookups bounded by the 30-field bound.** Acceptable, because parse cannot know which names are lookups. The ceiling is about 65 engine reads per call.
- **Composition by explicit plugin.** Matches D5. A host without the service registers nothing.
- **Lookup target refused without naming it.** This stays within the naming bound and is the conservative choice.
- **Registration.** The tool registers inside `registerObjectTools` under `canRead` rather than as its own `#wireBridgeTools` step. The gate is equivalent, so this is accepted.
- **SQL push-down.** No new id materialisation and no in-app join. Expansion is the engine's batched read. The second root read by id (:363-367) is the `expand` read that D3 names.
- **Author.** The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, and the PR is a draft. CI on this head is red (R3).

### ④ Design judgment
- **ai-context.zod.ts.** Sound for the executor and the showcase packs, but it fails the ADR-0122 alias gate (R3).
- **record-context-tools.zod.ts.** Input and output are declared once and projected. The MCP door registers the zod input directly, as the dataset tools do. It has the same ADR-0122 gap (R3).
- **Kernel, meta-spelling, stack and index files.** Each is consistent with the `skill` rows, and the generated file matches.
- **platform-tool-names.ts.** The door name joins. `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` is correctly left to row 9.
- **SKILL.md.** The content is correct, but the file is over its shrink-only token ceiling (R3).
- **First consumer.** The executor and both MCP doors are in this PR. The execution plan holds except for R1, R2, R4 and R5.

### Findings
- **R1 must-fix (security).** Outline parsing of record body text must run in time linear in the body's length, whatever the body holds, and must be pinned by an adversarial-input test. The body is untrusted record text (body-outline.ts, called from record-context-tools.ts:444). Details have gone to the implementing thread.
- **R2 must-fix (security, order and naming).** No definition of a pack's `related` child may be read before that child's object-level judgement. Any refusal arising from such a read must come out as the one unnamed `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Today `planObjectsOf` (record-context-tools.ts:263, read-set.ts:138) reads child definitions before the gates at :275-287. The two transports can then answer the same call differently, which breaks D4's one-code rule and transport parity. Details have gone to the implementing thread.
- **R3 must-fix.** Six gates are red on this head, all caused by this diff:
  - the published-skills token ratchet (SKILL.md is 6152 tokens against a ceiling of 6148);
  - the ADR-0122 parsed-alias convention (12 violations across the two new zod files);
  - generated references (`content/docs/references/ai/ai-context.mdx` is stale);
  - the `packages/spec/llms.txt` counts;
  - the test-source alias gate (showcase `vitest.config`);
  - WHERE-matcher conformance (mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts:94).

  The SKILL.md fix changes governed text, so the delta needs a re-read.
- **R4 should-fix (security, fail closed).** A surviving lookup whose target is not in the planned read set must be dropped or refused. At record-context-tools.ts:352 it skips the read guard but stays in the expand list (:345, :365, :394). This is reachable when the served and published definitions disagree, which can happen on stdio (stdio-data-bridge.ts:1877-1880).
- **R5 should-fix.** A multi-valued link field is filtered by equality (record-context-tools.ts:392), whereas `get_record`'s related list uses `$contains` (mcp-relation-reads.ts:255-256). The list comes back silently empty, and no lint rule or test covers it.
- **R6 should-fix.** The parity test runs one stdio bridge under two MCP transports (mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts:102-116, :160-164). The HTTP data bridge's door (runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:1680-1698) is only wiring-tested against a mocked executor. Run the real executor over both bridges on one fixture, refusals included. Also add one read over a registry-served row, because read-set.ts:47-54 silently drops a row that doesn't parse.
- **R7 should-fix.** D1's "reported at save" is not built: the rule is `CLI_ONLY` (authoring-rules.ts:1972-1978). The kind allows runtime create (metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1388), and the tool is silent on author defects (record-context-tools.ts:300-303, :323). Either build it, or file a follow-up card before row 7 and name it in the PR body. The `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line needs its card number.
- **R8 nit.** The catch at record-context-tools.ts:281-285 turns any throw from the exposure gate, a server fault included, into a named `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- **R9 nit.**
  - Notes are written in en and zh-Hans (sentences.ts:15), but the framing is in four languages (record-material-envelope.ts:33).
  - A related list has no order, so the 20-row cut is unstable (:391-396).
  - The spec says "plural label" (record-context-tools.zod.ts:121), but the executor serves `label` (:417).
  - A withheld body is appended to `fields` and can duplicate an entry (:464-467).

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `73d03bbcde6fff411100dae49acd6b1c370831fd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/index.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/record-context-tools.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/collection-item-owner-stamp.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/meta-url-data.generated.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md + delta `edba9689..73d03bbc` (cb5e8b8f, 76eabb5c, 73d03bbc; the merge of main read only where it meets this diff): packages/services/service-record-context/src/body-outline.ts, record-context-tools.ts, __tests__/body-outline.test.ts (new), __tests__/fake-door.ts, __tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts, packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.legacy-overlay-delete.test.ts, packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts, packages/spec/llms.txt, examples/app-showcase/vitest.config.ts, regenerated references and api-surface files. Files unchanged since `edba9689` stand as reviewed in 7149757761.
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments
- **R1, outline reading is now linear.** The two heading patterns are gone, and every reader in body-outline.ts:41-138 is a forward scan.
  - `isFence` and `markdownHeadingOf` (:46-65) each walk a line once.
  - `htmlHeadingsOf` (:88-138) advances `pos` on every iteration. Its `>` search and its per-level closing-tag search are memoised and only asked from non-decreasing positions.
  - `stripTags` (:68-80) is one pass, and the remaining regexes have no nested quantifiers.
  - The worst cases (many unclosed openers, openers with no tag end, long whitespace runs, nested tags) were reasoned through, and each stays linear.
- **R2, a child's gates come before any read of its definition.** The order is guard, then served, then exposure (record-context-tools.ts:279-298). `planObjectsOf` runs after that, through `publishedOf` (:303-311), which turns any throw into the unnamed `PERMISSION_DENIED`. A child is named only on `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` or `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (:227, :293-296), and only after the served definition came back non-null. So naming stays inside the bound.
- **R4.** An unplanned lookup target refuses the call unnamed, before any read (:376-378).
- **R5.** A multi-valued link filters with `$contains` (:418), read off the served field definition (:360). The fake door refuses every other operator.

### ② Semver level
Unchanged. The change is additive, ships `minor` on each package, and declares `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added`. The delta adds only `XParsed` type aliases (ADR-0122) and regenerated files.

### ③ Boundary flags
- **CI.** CI was not finished at read time, and R3's closure is from the diff. The seat checks for full green before ACCEPT.
- **SKILL.md.** The key list is unchanged. The trimmed sentence ("A phantom key like `roles:` or `policies:` is refused: the stack fails to load") is accurate, and the ratchet script is not touched.
- **Overlayable tier.** `ai_context` joining `ROLLED_BACK_OVERLAYABLE_TYPES` pins the registry row (`supportsOverlay: true`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`, the `skill` row's flags, as in ADR-0160 D1).
- **Mechanical changes.** The owner-stamp fixture row, the form bundles and the llms.txt counts (228→230, ai 14→16, packages 75→76) are mechanical.
- **SQL push-down.** Nothing new.
- **Author.** The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment
- Spec modules: only the parsed-state aliases were added, and the accepted set is unchanged.
- SKILL.md: sound as governed text.
- Executor: its plan now holds for R1, R2, R4 and R5, each pinned by a test (body-outline.test.ts; the record-context-tools.test.ts ordering, unnamed-refusal, unplanned-target and `$contains` cases; the MCP disabled-package parity case).

### Findings
- R1 closed. R2 closed. R3 closed in the diff, with CI confirmation at ACCEPT. R4 closed. R5 closed.
- R6 is moved to #37175: the real-executor HTTP-bridge rig, refusals included, plus one registry-served row.
- R7 is moved to #37176: author defects reported at save, which must land before row 7 (#37143).
- The Skills-docs follow-up is #37177.
- R8, R9: nits, accepted as deviations.
- **R10 (should-fix) is moved to #37178.** The outline has no cap on entries, so a body made mostly of headings yields an answer that grows with the body. #37178 caps the entries, adds a note when the cap cuts, and pins the constant.
- **R11 (nit).** The linearity test asserts wall-clock time (body-outline.test.ts:79-86). It has about an order of magnitude of headroom, and a step counter would be sturdier.
- **R12 (nit).** `publishedOf` and the served-read catch (:285-289, :303-311) answer a server fault as an unreadable object. That is safe but misleading for an operator.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9ae6a3bfa1b361e326b3d6354afafa0ff9c81f32`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/index.ts, packages/spec/src/ai/record-context-tools.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/collection-item-owner-stamp.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/meta-url-data.generated.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md + delta `73d03bbc..9ae6a3bf` (one commit): .changeset/37140-ai-context-get-record-context.md, packages/cli/test/metadata-type-schema-gate.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/bare-type-display-echo-decisions.test.ts and object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (11). Read-only outside the delta: packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts, ADR-0150 on main, scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs, packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts, the finished check-runs of `73d03bbc`. Files unchanged since the earlier heads stand as reviewed there.
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments
- **The PASS at `73d03bbc` (7149818851) is superseded.** It was given on a read of the diff while CI was still running. That head's CI finished with two gates red, both from this PR, and `9ae6a3bf` touches neither file (R13, R14). The SKILL.md trim was also wrongly judged sound: a gate pins the phrase it removed.
- **The original six R3 gates are closed, and CI confirms it.** On `73d03bbc` the token ratchet, the ADR-0122 aliases, the generated references, llms.txt, the showcase alias and the WHERE-matcher all passed.
- **This delta is consistent bookkeeping.**
  - The catalog counts move by one type that has a label and no description (33 / 16 / 27 / 825).
  - The CLI schema gate lists `ai_context` as closed at `aiContexts`.
  - Pending changes gains a count row, with each locale's plural family matching its `skill` row.
- **No executor, door or schema file changed,** so the security judgments of the last two records stand.

### ② Semver level
`Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` are unchanged and correct. The three new changeset entries are `patch`, which AGENTS.md step 3 does not allow here (R16).

### ③ Boundary flags
- **The ADR-0150 bucketing call.** Leaving `ai_context` out of `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` is right for this PR, but the gap it leaves needs a ruling (R15).
  - The constant mirrors ADR-0150 D1's ruled table (core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts:245), so adding a type amends that ruling. ADR-0160 point 9 copies only the `skill` row's registry flags, file suffix and collection key.
  - The one reader of a pack takes a bare name and reads the merged listing, so the test comment describes the tree accurately.
  - At runtime, two packages may each ship a pack of one name. The registry keeps both. The metadata service keeps one copy by name, which is also what an overlay binds to. Owner stamps and uninstall stay per package.
- **Check-runs.** On `9ae6a3bf` at read time: 0 failed, two lanes still running. Final on `73d03bbc`: 5 failed, from R13 and R14.
- **SQL push-down.** Nothing in the delta.
- **Author.** The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment
- **SKILL.md.** The key list is right, but the page no longer carries the sentence its own gate quotes (R13), so the governed text is not landable at this head.
- **Other `hits` files.** Unchanged, and they stand as judged.
- **Execution plan.** Unchanged, except that R15 adds one gap on the pack-selection path.

### Findings
Status of earlier findings:
- Closed: R1, R2, R4, R5. R3's six gates are closed, but the lanes are red for R13 and R14.
- Deferred: R6 to #37175; R7 to #37176 (before row 7); R10 to #37178.
- Nits: R8, R9, R11, R12.
- Skills-docs: #37177. The changeset body should carry that number.

New:
- **R13 must-fix.** The SKILL.md trim in cb5e8b8f removed the sentence `check-skill-top-level-keys` pins as the page's contract (scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs:77, :195). Its self-test is red on `73d03bbc`. Restore the pinned sentence and pay its tokens by deleting a different restatement. Do not edit the gate.
